summary.text: James Lomax, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 20 since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He earned a B.A. in communications from the University of Alabama in Huntsville in 2013 and an M.A. in civic leadership from Lipscomb University in 2017.

His career experience includes working as vice president of asset management and leasing at Corporate Office Properties Trust, an associate with Colliers International and a commercial leasing agent with NAI Chase Commercial.
